 WAVY Norfolk Wed, November 18, 2026 at 10:40 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. North Carolina counties could lose millions of dollars in local sales tax to cover the cost of SNAP benefits. The change was tucked into a sweeping, 62-page budget bill passed by the General Assembly Tuesday. Link: https://wavy.com
